## Hourly Deep

All 12 occurrences of "nightly" in `docs/dream-design.md` were checked. Only one is load-bearing: the review page (`:778`, `:825`), where the constraint is the operator's attention — "Roughly: 20 is reviewable, 200 gets skipped."

The rest are incidental. `:757` says nightly because it is the heavy pass on a big model — a cost argument that flat-rate subscriptions erase. `:687` worries the pass "would degrade as the corpus grows", already solved by the covering index. `:1243` makes "nightly run exceeding max duration" a circuit-breaker condition, which is a duration check, not a cadence requirement.

The fix for the page is **decoupling, not cadence**: Deep commits hourly, the review queue accumulates, the operator reads it once a morning. Items above the commit band land within the hour instead of waiting up to 24.

## The page shrinks because Deep learns, not because we filter

| When | Page shows | Because |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | everything | no labels exist |
| End of week 1 | 10-15% | Deep has a week of operator labels |
| End of month 1 | <10% | patterns established |
| Steady state | 2-5% | only the genuinely inconsistent |

**The rate is an output, not a schedule.** Nothing sets it. It falls as agreement rises; if it stops falling, that is a real signal the residual is genuinely hard.

The morning report has two parts: **what was decided** (skimmable, no action, this part grows) and **what could not be** (the 2-5%, the only part that costs attention). The first part is what makes the second trustworthy — a shrinking queue with no visible decisions gives no evidence the shrink was earned.

## The mechanism already exists

`src/db/migrations/037_candidate_memory_uncertainty.sql`:
- `review_action` — human label, ground truth
- `machine_grade` — REM's prediction, structurally separated (`037:43-46`)
- `graded_by` — provenance
- `037:55`: "machine_grade is the prediction; review_action is the label. Their disagreement rate IS the" [metric]

`dream-design.md:783` promised "Rico ranking picks become reference data — the feedback loop that tunes the threshold" and never said how. This is how.

## Supersession this creates — must be explicit

`src/candidate-review.ts:23-29` records that the 0.2-0.5 band page (`dream-design.md:775-781`) is already superseded by the operator's 2026-07-28 "let everything pass" decision: queue predicate is `reviewed_at IS NULL`, and `uncertain`/`machine_grade` affect only sort order.

The ramp requires Deep to decide items so they never enter the queue — setting `reviewed_at` with `graded_by = 'auto:...'`, which `037:60` currently forbids. Both rules are right for their moment; "let everything pass" was correct when nothing had ever been graded. This is a genuine reversal of a same-day decision and must be written as one, with auto-decided items always attributed so the trail distinguishes "Rico decided" from "the model was trusted to decide."

## Review outcomes become retrievable

Operator ranking pairs become an embedded, retrievable table **in the same database** — not a separate vector store. Distinguished by authority, not location: `docs/code-brain-design.md` R3 tiers are canon > decided > observed, and an operator ranking is the strongest kind of `decided`. It is a tier, not a database.

## Risk

Hourly multiplies the commit rate by 24. `:806-816` requires confidence from corroboration, not model self-report. If confidence is self-reported, hourly turns a slow leak into a fast one. **Build the corroboration counter before raising the cadence.**

## Blocked on data

`machine_grade` is empty; the only human labels are 8 smoke-test grades on the replaced fragment population, which need blanking and redoing. The ramp cannot begin until a first week of real labels exists.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Deep runs hourly, bounded by duration not by cadence
- [ ] Corroboration counter lands before the cadence is raised
- [ ] Morning report shows decided and undecided separately
- [ ] Auto-decided items always carry `graded_by = 'auto:...'`; never silent
- [ ] Operator rankings are embedded and readable by recall as `decided` authority
- [ ] The "let everything pass" supersession is written down, not implied
